english.title: Occupier / manager of smoke-free public playgrounds fail to display sign - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who occupied or was concerned in the management of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which were smoke-free by virtue of section 12 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017 (public playgrounds), failed to ensure that at least one sign was displayed at the premises which contained a legible graphic representation of a burning cigarette enclosed in a circle with a bar across the circle which crosses the cigarette symbol and was displayed in a prominent position

(A)_[at or near the main entrance]_
(B)_[at or near each of the main entrances]_
(C)_[near the playground]_

and included the appropriate warning text
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 14(1)(c), (2) and (3) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020 and section 17(1), (5) and (8) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.

english.notes:
(i) In the case of public playgrounds within clearly marked boundaries, the sign or signs must be displayed in a prominent position at or near each main entrance; in the case of public playgrounds not within clearly marked boundaries, the signs need to be in a prominent position near the playground, see regulation 14(2) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020.
(ii) The full required 'appropriate warning text' can be found in regulation 14(3).
(iii) For defences to this offence, see section 17(6) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.
(iv) The fixed penalty amount is £200 (regulation 20(a) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020); the discounted amount £150 (regulation 21(a)). For the form of the fixed penalty notice, see regulation 22.
